Chile's expansion it's railway to it's southern most provinces and into the territory of Peru is nearly halfway complete. If the current schedule is maintained, the final new track will be laid before the end of next year.

There has never been direct access to the southern most tip of Chile. The only road into the Province Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena, is by route 9 from Argentina. The capital of Magallanes, Punta Arenas, is reached only via flight, or by ferry from Argentina.

The new rail system will change this level isolation, and bring all of the Chilean family closer together than ever before.

All of Chile is excitedly anticipating the day when the new high speed railway will have them within reach of Antarctica in a matter of hours.

New track has also been laid to the north, and lines are already operational between Santiago and the major hubs already in existence in Peru.
